visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Kai, a man with dark hair, wears a white t-shirt and faces the camera in a bright, modern indoor space. He holds a square black MAC cosmetic box, rotating it to show the label clearly. His facial expressions are animated and welcoming as he begins his presentation. (2) Kai unboxes the product, revealing a matte black circular compact. He opens it to show the internal mirror and a sponge applicator. He demonstrates the refillable feature by pulling the inner tray out of the casing with his fingers, showcasing the product's modular design in a close-up. (3) He then presents a white tube of MAC primer. He shakes it vigorously with his right hand before applying the pinkish-purple cream to his cheeks and forehead, massaging it in with both hands. His face turns a vibrant pink hue, creating a noticeable visual contrast. (4) Using a black makeup sponge, Kai applies the powder foundation to his face. On-screen graphics display his specific shade, N18. He uses dabbing and sliding motions, looking into a hand mirror or the camera lens while smiling and gesturing towards the lens to emphasize coverage. (5) A montage sequence shows Kai in different environments. He is at a hair salon with a stylist's hands visible working on his hair, then eating at a small local noodle shop, and later lying back in a hair-washing basin with water flowing over his face. (6) Kai returns to the primary studio setting. He examines his reflection closely, touching his cheek to show the makeup's durability after the day's activities. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with the compact before a celebratory graphic shows a 7.5/10 score.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with high-tempo acoustic guitar BGM. Kai's voice is bright and energetic, with a fast speech rate and clear articulation. He uses a professional yet friendly narrative tone to introduce the new cosmetic product he received. (2) A tactile rustling sound of cardboard occurs as Kai unboxes the product. The BGM remains steady in the background. His vocal pitch is moderate, but his intonation is dynamic as he describes the physical features of the makeup compact. (3) A sharp digital whoosh effect marks the transition. Kai shakes a plastic bottle, creating a rhythmic liquid sloshing sound. He explains the primer's use, with his voice exhibiting high arousal and a slight comedic tone. (4) Whimsical, low-energy comedy BGM plays briefly as Kai expresses surprise. His voice becomes more animated and higher-pitched. A cartoonish 'boing' sound effect emphasizes his facial reaction to the product's color on his skin during application. (5) The upbeat pop BGM returns with a steady electronic beat. Kai's speech remains dense and fast. He provides detailed instructions on application techniques, with his voice maintaining a confident and authoritative yet accessible dominance throughout the segment. (6) A brief musical interlude occurs as Kai sings a few phrases. His vocal pitch increases, and he exhibits high emotional valence. The guitar strums match the rhythm of his singing, followed by a transition sound effect. (7) Field recording ambience of a hair salon, including the hum of a hair dryer and distant muffled chatter, replaces the BGM. Kai narrates his experience with a calm, conversational tone, his voice sounding slightly compressed. (8) Continuous water splashing and rushing sounds are heard. Kai's voice is slightly muffled and further back in the mix. He speaks while being washed, maintaining a humorous and lighthearted tone despite the intrusive ambient noise. (9) Back in the studio, the pop BGM swells in volume. Kai concludes his review with a final summary. The audio ends with a high-energy cartoon celebratory SFX, including cheering and a ding, as the text graphic appears.
